items.docs: Returns all available predefined regions currently stored in the SRA prediction system. These values can be used to quickly get predictions for regions without needing to know the exact list of FIPS.

info.name: Get FIPS for counties within redefined region.

params.name: region
params.description: Name of predefined region

items.docs: Passing in a predefined region name will return a list of counties contained within the region. The "county" objects will contain general information about the county including known substation count, population, and total area (in square miles).

info.name: Get FIPS for counties within state.

params.name: state
params.description: Name or abbreviation of state

items.docs: Passing in a state name or abbreviation will return a list of counties contained within the state. The "county" objects will contain general information about the county including known substation count, population, and total area (in square miles).

info.name: Get predictions for FIP(s) or region by date range

params.name: startTime
params.description: ISO 8601, start time of predictions.

params.name: endTime
params.description: ISO 8601, end time of predictions.

params.name: fipsList
params.description: A single or comma seperated list of FIPS to get predictions for.

params.name: predictionType
params.description: Type of predictions, either customers-out or risk-index. Defaults to customers-out

params.name: lat
params.description: Latitude of point which is used to get predictions for county that contains it.

params.name: lon
params.description: Longitude of point which is used to get predictions for county that contains it.

params.name: regionName
params.description: Can be a predefined, named region, a state abbreviation or full state name.

params.name: timezoneId
params.description: IANA timezone string to auto adjust prediction timestamps.

items.docs: Get predictions for FIP(s) or region by date range. startTime and endTime as well as one positional definition (like lat and lon or regionName).
